sources.title: AMT Electronics Rammstein Du Hast Distortion Combo Emulator
sources.excerpt: The exact Reverb listing identifies the AMT Electronics Rammstein Du Hast Distortion Combo Emulator as the first version. The listing describes it as a distortion/combo emulator and gives Volume, Distortion, High, and Low controls. The unit is presented as a thick, crunchy metal-oriented AMT distortion.
